senses.definition: n.pr.loc. E. of Jordan;—only in phr. וָהֵב בְּס׳ in ancient poet. fragment Nu 21:14; TristrMoab 50 cp. Ṣāfieh (صافيه), SE. oasis of Dead Sea, but ס = ص is most improb.
